reviews.author: Abhay Yadav
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience. The food was pathetic, and the manager’s behaviour was extremely rude and unprofessional. We came here with high expectations to celebrate a family member’s birthday, hoping to have a wonderful time together, but the entire experience turned out to be a huge disappointment.

The food quality was nowhere near what we expected, and the way we were treated made the experience even worse. A special occasion like a birthday deserves good food, warm hospitality, and a pleasant atmosphere, but unfortunately, we experienced none of these.

This was genuinely one of the worst dining experiences we’ve had. Very disappointing, and definitely not a place we would recommend based on our experience.
